plan.title: feat(update): dry-run plan via side-effect port (ADR-004)

narratives.Description: feat(update): dry-run plan via side-effect port (ADR-004) — construction-level collection; 3453 prior art; closes #3437
narratives.Origin: Operator-accepted #3462 Current shape + ADR-004. Replaces halted PR 3453 collect-only. Comment 5331467144 (2026-08-18T17:01:50Z) only records ADR-004 landing on master via PR #3466 — confirmation, not an AC change. Intentional divergence: this replacement brief already implements ADR-004.
narratives.Overview:
PR 3453 collect-only failed after five bypasses. #3462 critic + operator acceptance chose the side-effect port: every dest mutation on deft update goes through one injected write/remove/exec interface; dry-run records those calls. #3437 stays open until this PR merges.

ADR-004 conditions (must land):
1. Enforcement legs: static ban extended to dest-mutating child_process/git (allowlist = port module only) plus the zero-mutation fixture.
2. Migration is consolidation: fold the 3 existing dest-mutating seams (GitHooksSeams, copyContent, runOrgForceOn) into the port; do not wrap a fourth abstraction. containedWrite/containedRemove is the chokepoint to extend.
3. Honest exclusions label survives and shrinks; content-contract test; never silently disappears.

Prior art: PR 3453 (road not taken), #3458 precursor, #3464 version-skew headline.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer running deft update --dry-run, I want the plan to be the dest mutations the real run would make (including deletes vs preserves), so I can see blast radius without a lying collect-only mode.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Extend containedWrite/containedRemove (or the named port module) to dest-mutating exec/chmod. 2. Fold GitHooksSeams, copyContent, runOrgForceOn into that port. 3. Dry-run binds the port in record mode; planned dest set = recorded calls. 4. Extend the static ban to child_process/git dest mutations; allowlist = port module(s) only. 5. Printed exclusions label + content-contract; shrink as sites fold. 6. Zero-mutation fixture stays green. 7. CHANGELOG. Closes #3437. ⊗ Collect-only revival. ⊗ Labeled two-tree dest-vs-content-package plan.

items.title: Port covers dest write, remove, chmod, and dest-mutating git/exec

narrative.Acceptance: Given the update path, when a dest file write, dest remove, chmod, or dest-mutating git config runs, then it goes through the port module. Dry-run records the call and does not mutate dest.

Given GitHooksSeams, copyContent, and runOrgForceOn, when the replacement lands, then those seams call the port rather than a new parallel wrapper. ADR-004 inventory count stays 3 unless the ADR is amended.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts + packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts (GitHooksSeams, copyContent, runOrgForceOn fold into containedWrite/Remove)

items.title: Static ban covers child_process dest mutations

narrative.Acceptance: Given a dest-mutating execFileSync git invocation on the update path outside the port module, when the contract test runs, then it fails. The fs-only ban remaining green while git config mutates is the instance-5 failure this AC forbids.

items.title: Zero-mutation fixture remains the runtime backstop

narrative.Acceptance: Given the planted xbrief/vbrief.md hash fixture, when deft update --dry-run runs, then the tree is byte-identical.

items.title: Honest exclusions label with shrinking contract

narrative.Acceptance: Given a dest effect the port cannot yet capture, when dry-run prints, then the exclusions label names it and a content-contract test fails if the category is missing. The label never disappears silently.
Given the ship, when the replacement PR merges, then CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3462 / ADR-004 and GitHub closes #3437.
